title: Crime of the Sparkling Heist
story:
In the opulent city of Glitzville, a dazzling event was about to take place at the prestigious Diamond Royale Ballroom. Guests were eagerly anticipating the grand unveiling of two priceless diamond gems: the Star of Dazzle and the Radiance Royal. 

As the night unfolded, the Director of Diamond Affairs, Mr. Brighton, approached the city's Chief Inspector, informed of a mysterious disappearance of the priceless diamonds. Suddenly, the event manager, Miss Sapphire, announced, 'Something is amiss! Our security cameras recorded a break-in, but the thief left no trace behind.' The Star of Dazzle and Radiance Royal are nowhere to be found.
victim: Director of Diamond Affairs, Mr. Brighton
forensicClue: An oddly shaped stone found near the crime scene
question: Which guest is the thief? How did the detective solve it?
options: Option A: Lady Opal (found wearing an oddly shaped stone pendant)
Option B: Lord Topaz (left the event abruptly before the theft)
